SOLAR SYSTEM / Branches of arts already present

Horary, electional, natal & mundane astrology.

Branches of astrology distinguished by the moment, question and subject for which a chart is interpreted.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Horary astrology
Astrología horaria

Astrological interpretation of a chart cast for the moment associated with a question.

Electional astrology
Astrología electiva

Astrological selection of a proposed time for an intended activity.

Natal astrology
Astrología natal

Astrological interpretation of a chart for a birth.

Mundane astrology
Astrología mundana

Astrological interpretation concerning collective affairs, places or public events.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Each branch can use different schools, house systems, zodiacs and timing rules. A chart’s purpose and calculation settings should remain visible alongside the reading.

Solar system

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Name the branch and the source of the date, time and place.
  2. Record zodiac, house system, time offset and chart style.
  3. Keep the calculated chart separate from the school’s interpretive claims.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Export the whole chart with its settings and date visible.
  • Redact names and private birth details unless required for the submitted question.
